title: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Rice
subtitle: juicy seared shrimp in a lemony garlic butter sauce, spooned over buttery rice with roasted broccoli
imageAlt: Seared shrimp in golden garlic butter sauce over white rice with a lemon wedge
servingsNote: dinner for one big eater + one hungry eater, plus 2 lunches

breakdown: Raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, 680 g bag (frozen)

beforeYouStart.text: Frozen shrimp: thaw in the fridge overnight, or in a sealed bag in cold water for 20–30 minutes. Pat very dry.
Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) for the broccoli.

items.name: raw shrimp
items.note: peeled & deveined, tails off, thawed (31–40 size)

items.name: lemon
items.note: juice of ½, rest in wedges

steps.title: Garlic rice
steps.text: Melt the rice butter in a pot over medium and cook the 2 cloves of garlic 30 seconds. Add the rinsed rice, water and a pinch of salt; boil, cover and simmer on low 15 minutes, then rest 10 minutes with the lid on.

steps.title: Roast the broccoli
steps.text: Toss the florets with olive oil and salt on a sheet pan. Roast at 220°C (425°F) 16–18 minutes until the edges are toasted, then toss with the Parmesan.

steps.title: Season the shrimp
steps.text: Pat the shrimp very dry (wet shrimp steam instead of sear). Toss with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat the oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook 1–1½ minutes per side until pink and just opaque. Move to a plate — they finish in the sauce.

steps.title: Garlic butter sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium-low. Add the remaining 3 tbsp butter and the garlic; cook 30–60 seconds until fragrant, not brown. Add the broth and lemon juice and simmer 1–2 minutes until slightly reduced.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Return the shrimp and any juices, toss 30 seconds to coat and warm through. Spoon over the garlic rice with the broccoli and lemon wedges.

fixIt.fix: They were overcooked — shrimp take 2–3 minutes total. Pull them as soon as they turn opaque and curl into a loose C (a tight O means overcooked).
It browned. Lower the heat before adding garlic and keep it moving.
Simmer the broth and lemon a little longer so it emulsifies with the butter, and swirl the pan.
Pat them really dry and don't crowd the pan.

saleTip: Bags of frozen raw shrimp (680 g) at No Frills often drop to about $10–12 on flyer weeks — buy two and keep one in the freezer for a fast date night.
swap: Chicken thighs in bite-size pieces (cook to 74°C / 165°F), or scallops. Toss with spaghetti instead of rice for garlic butter shrimp pasta.
leftovers: Fridge 2–3 days. Shrimp are best fresh — reheat gently.
source: Based on tested garlic butter shrimp methods (Damn Delicious, Cafe Delites): dry shrimp seared briefly, garlic butter-lemon pan sauce; seafood temp per Health Canada.
prepAhead: Thaw the shrimp in the fridge overnight.
Mince the garlic and cut the broccoli a day ahead.
reheat: Low and gentle: covered in a skillet over low 2–3 minutes, or microwave at 50% power in 30-second bursts, just until hot (74°C / 165°F).

basic.note: Garlic butter shrimp over plain rice with steamed broccoli.

stepNotes.4: Basic: butter, garlic and lemon — a splash of water instead of broth.

fancy.note: Golden shrimp in a lemony garlic butter with Parmesan-roasted broccoli and garlic rice.

stepNotes.4: Fancy: swirl in the extra butter and zest off the heat for a glossy sauce.

plating: Shrimp curled in a ring on top of the rice.
Sauce spooned over, then a little zest.
Broccoli on one side, lemon wedge on the other.

why.0-0: Dry shrimp sear; wet ones steam and go rubbery.
why.0-6: Butter is the sauce — less butter, less sauce.
